entries.source: Regesta Boica 11 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 11 = Continuatio 7), 26 March 1406
entries.german: Hans von Rosenberg quittirt dem Burggrafen Friedrich zu Nürnberg 150 Gulden. D. eod. d. (c. 1 S.)
entries.english: Hans von Rosenberg acknowledges receipt of 150 gulden from Burgrave Friedrich of Nuremberg. Dated the same day. (With 1 seal.)

facts.content: issued a quittance to Burgrave Friedrich of Nuremberg for 150 gulden.
